g9_required.A: Explicit real-time consolidated UTP Tape-C UQDF+UTDF / National NBBO lineage or documented equivalent redistributor
g9_required.B: Machine bid+ask+last with independent quote-event and trade-event timestamps; RTH quote<=60s, trade<=60s, max quote/trade skew<=15s
g9_required.C: Lawful intended automated/non-display permanent-$0 entitlement with no market-data/vendor/exchange/per-query/account-maintenance fee or activity/balance condition required to retain it
g9_required.D: Callable from actual canonical scheduler with secrets protected

findings.evidence: UTP is the authoritative Tape-C consolidated source, but published direct non-display/access fees are not permanent $0.

US LV1 is free and callable by REST/WebSocket; connected runtime proves live bid/ask and trade ticks. Longbridge separately describes Consolidated U.S. Market Data including NBBO as a distinct subscription/promotion, so free US LV1 cannot be assumed consolidated NBBO. Current ChatGPT depth connector also does not expose an independent quote-event timestamp.

Turkey appears in the TradeStation application country list; current API provides MarketData, ReadAccount and Matrix scopes; current client model for v3 participant-level market-depth quotes exposes RFC3339 TimeStamp while quote snapshots expose Bid/Ask/Last/TradeTime/MarketFlags.IsDelayed. Qualified non-professional Nasdaq Level I is included without a separate data charge. However the reviewed primary sources do not prove the exact retail API entitlement is consolidated UTP/NBBO for automated/non-display use at permanent $0, and TradeStation currently publishes a $10 monthly inactivity fee unless balance/trading conditions are met.
dxFeed can technically provide true UTP Tape-C/NBBO plus independent quote/trade event timestamps, but current commercial access is paid and therefore not permanent $0.
Technically promising consolidated all-exchanges feed, but current official international-account eligibility excludes Turkey.
Free real-time equities are IEX; SIP is not a permanent-$0 real-time entitlement. Historical/delayed SIP remains NON-G9.
Free US equity data is non-consolidated Cboe One/IEX; consolidated Network C/UTP data is paid.

falsification_condition: Promote to G9 PASS only after primary-source proof for the exact callable entitlement establishes A and C, AND live scheduled RTH probe proves B and D for AAPL+NVDA within freshness/skew limits.

account_gate.fix: Reconnect/re-authorize Longbridge OAuth. Then require successful read-only account_balance + stock_positions in the same run. Never store account values in repository and never call order endpoints.
